reason: A DSH Web plugin that monitors DeepSeek API balance and usage, estimates available tokens using configurable pricing, and presents the information through sidebar badges, detail panels, and charts.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web 侧边栏监控 DeepSeek API 余额与用量，并根据可配置的模型和时段计价估算可用 token 数。
summaries.en: Monitors DeepSeek API balance and usage in the DSH Web sidebar and estimates available tokens using configurable model and time-period pricing.

capabilities: Reads a configured DeepSeek API credential reference
Displays quota, estimated token availability, pricing, and per-round usage charts
Stores and applies user-configured pricing and peak-period settings
